title: 品牌平面纸风格
prompt: A flat branded paper folds itself into the full 3D shape of a [Air Jordan 1 shoes], mid-motion. Dramatic studio lighting, origami texture detail, gradient shadows, Japanese minimalism feel.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro，打造日式极简纸艺风格品牌视觉，适用于时尚与零售行业的产品发布和生活方式营销，通过戏剧性光影与折纸纹理呈现动态效果。
